title: NCAA: Generals secure twice-to-beat bonus, edge Chiefs to sweep second round
summary: Emilio Aguinaldo College secured the last twice-to-beat bonus in Group B after edging Arellano University, 102-93, in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Monday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
